prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Thinking back to that Chengdu trip in 2025—it's funny how we kept chatting about what was playing in town and where to eat.
We ended up watching Kung Fu Panda 4, and I remember the showtime was 16:30—felt like the whole afternoon disappeared.
My cousin handled the tickets though—she picked Wanda Cinema Jinhua and bought 4 seats, so I basically just showed up.
And the order confirmation had my name on it—Zhou Jun—which was kind of annoying because I didn’t even click anything.
Lunch the next day was at Chen Mapo Tofu; Li Na made the reservation for 2025-03-26 and it was for 7 people, super loud table.
She set it for 11:30, used her own contact name Li Na, and the phone she put down was 13845678901. Also I remember we canceled our ride later—ride ID was RIDE789012—because we just walked.
